name: Angel Hair Salon & Day Spa
description: Here at Angel Hair Salon & Boutique, we are dedicated to making you look and feel your best. Our staff is highly trained in all hair types and a wide range of techniques. Whether you are looking for a spunky new do, a jaw dropping makeover, or a glamorous outfit for a night out on the town, our stylists are here to help. Our goal is to give you exactly what you want and the undivided attention you deserve! We offer a wide range of services, guaranteed to make you look and feel fabulous.
